title: Distributed Systems Reading Group
summary:
The supplied URL is not a research paper or a paper-description page; it is the homepage of MIT’s Distributed Systems Reading Group. The page lists papers discussed by the group, including work on consensus, replication, transactions, streaming systems, and distributed databases, with brief descriptions of several entries. ([dsrg.pdos.csail.mit.edu](https://dsrg.pdos.csail.mit.edu/))

A web search found that the group met approximately every other week at MIT and covered both contemporary and seminal distributed-systems research. The site itself has been referenced as a distributed-systems reading resource, and Neha Narula’s biography identifies her as the organizer of the group. However, I found no reliable evidence that the reading-group homepage itself influenced subsequent research or industry practice. ([dsrg.pdos.csail.mit.edu](https://dsrg.pdos.csail.mit.edu/about/))
